text:
[LCON.2.1] Required: bit-for-bit identity. Runtime runs on its
claimed platform signature; test outputs are compared
byte-for-byte against the catalogue's recorded
reference outputs.
gap_reason: No fixture pins this. This is the core within-platform requirement every other section-2 category specialises, and it IS testable — a real vector compares byte-for-byte against the catalogue reference outputs. Asserted rather than left derived so the gap is visible instead of implied by an absence.
